summary.intent: Resolve PR review comments on PR #318, refactor api-client from singleton to instance-scoped axios, and investigate a throttle bypass gap identified in load testing.
summary.outcome: All PR review comments resolved across multiple rounds; api-client fully migrated from singleton to per-CipherBoxClient instance with shared instance threading through web app; throttle bypass gap confirmed closed; guard unit tests added; 20+ files changed across 6 packages.

repo: The web app uses two call paths into the API: direct generated function calls (auth, shares, device approval, vault init) and CipherBoxClient-mediated calls (folder/file/bin ops) — Phase 19.1 was only partially completed for the web app rewiring
BypassableThrottlerGuard.canActivate() returns true before calling super.canActivate(), meaning per-endpoint @Throttle decorators are never consulted when the bypass header is present
The IPFS controller uses only JwtAuthGuard with no throttle guard — IPFS operations are never rate-limited
sdk-core IPFS functions (addToIpfs, unpinFromIpfs) were using bare axios.post() with manual token injection instead of the instance-scoped axios, bypassing 401 refresh interceptors
The 429 errors in load tests during pnpm test (all packages) are caused by parallel test suites hitting the live API simultaneously, not a code bug — tests pass in isolation

Zero-knowledge architecture means rootIpnsName, rootFolderKey, and teeKeys must be provided explicitly at CipherBoxClient creation — the SDK cannot discover them, making those config fields intentional

code.finding: customInstance was refactored to accept optional _axiosInstance in options object, bypassing singleton when provided; createAxiosInstance now handles 401 refresh logic that was previously in getCachedInstance
SdkContext gained optional axiosInstance field for threading per-client axios instance through all SDK operations
createAndPublishIpnsRecord, batchPublishIpnsRecords, and resolveIpnsRecord all updated to accept optional ctx and forward axiosInstance to API calls
CipherBoxClient constructor now creates its own axios instance via createAxiosInstance(); accepts optional external axiosInstance via config for shared-instance pattern with web app
Rewired to create ONE axios instance with auth + 401 refresh, register it as singleton via setApiClientConfig, and export it for CipherBoxClient to share
initSdkClient now imports and passes the shared axiosInstance from api-config.ts to CipherBoxClient, unifying both call paths onto one instance
destroyClientPool zeroes out privateKey, rootFolderKey, and rootIpnsKeypair.privateKey after client.destroy() to clear key material
After ctx threading, mock assertions needed updating — ipnsControllerPublishRecord now called with two args (data + undefined options)
New unit test file created covering: bypass header present/absent, header value validation, super.canActivate delegation, and express-adapter context extraction

workflow: When resolving PR review threads, check if issues were already addressed by earlier commits in the same session before implementing new fixes
curl -s succeeds silently on HTTP 5xx; use curl -fsS to fail on server errors in health check loops
Running pnpm test across all packages in parallel against a live API triggers rate limiting; always run affected packages in isolation to verify test results
The gsd check-todos workflow correctly routes todos to roadmap phases and can identify when a todo was created before a fix was applied in the same session

friction: 429 errors during full pnpm test run caused repeated false-positive test failures requiring isolation reruns with cooldown delays

TypeScript AxiosInstance type couldn't be resolved via dynamic import('axios') in sdk and sdk-core packages because axios wasn't a direct dependency — required using re-export from @cipherbox/api-client instead
Jest coverage collection didn't instrument the throttler-bypass guard when testing with jest.spyOn — coverage report showed incorrect numbers despite all code paths being exercised
Phase 19.1 roadmap showed 6/6 plans complete with unchecked checkboxes, creating ambiguity about actual completion status
open_items: Web app direct api-client imports (13 files: auth, vault init, health, shares, invites, device approval, IPFS, IPNS hooks) still bypass CipherBoxClient — full Phase 19.1-05 rewiring deferred
fetchFromIpfs still uses native fetch() for streaming instead of the instance-scoped axios — intentionally left as-is but noted as inconsistency
Jest coverage configuration for api guard tests may need adjustment to correctly report instrumented coverage from unit tests vs integration passthrough
The singleton setApiClientConfig() and getCachedInstance() remain in the api-client package for backward compatibility with any consumers not yet using the instance-scoped path
